fieldValues.title: Should Research render as one readable document?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (3. Labels, headings and reading views), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Yes, with one composition section per thread and part, accepting the container literals (srs#851).
- B. Not until compositions can follow child sections by rule.
- C. No: navigation is the reading surface, and documents are per thread.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether readers use navigation or rendered documents, and what srs#851's rule would cost.
fieldValues.next_action: Render one thread with today's tools and ask a reader to compare it with navigating.
